## Epic Overview
Brief description of the epic and its strategic importance for the go-starter rebranding initiative.

## Strategic Context
- **Business Objective**: How this epic supports the transformation to AI-powered platform
- **User Impact**: How this affects individual developers and enterprise users
- **Market Position**: How this strengthens competitive differentiation

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Measurable outcome 1 (with specific metrics)
- [ ] Measurable outcome 2 (with specific metrics)
- [ ] User/stakeholder validation completed
- [ ] Quality gates met (specify standards)

## Dependencies
- [ ] Dependent epic/issue #xxx
- [ ] External requirement (budget approval, vendor selection, etc.)
- [ ] Research/validation prerequisite
- [ ] Technical/design prerequisite

## Timeline
- **Start Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Target Completion**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Critical Path**: Yes/No
- **Milestone**: Which project milestone this supports

## Budget Impact
- **Estimated Cost**: $X,XXX
- **Budget Approved**: Yes/No/Pending
- **Cost Center**: Marketing/Design/Engineering/External
- **Spend Timeline**: When costs will be incurred

## Deliverables
- [ ] Primary deliverable 1 (specify format/quality standards)
- [ ] Primary deliverable 2 (specify format/quality standards)
- [ ] Documentation/guidelines
- [ ] Success measurement report

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All dependent issues completed successfully
- [ ] Quality review passed (specify reviewer)
- [ ] Stakeholder sign-off received
- [ ] User validation (if applicable)
- [ ] Budget within 10% of estimate

## Risk Assessment
**High Risk:**
- Risk factor 1 and mitigation plan
- Risk factor 2 and mitigation plan

**Medium Risk:**
- Risk factor 1 and monitoring plan
- Risk factor 2 and monitoring plan

## Related Issues
- Closes #xxx, #xxx (child issues)
- Depends on #xxx (blocking dependencies)
- Related to #xxx (related epics)

## Team Assignment
- **Epic Owner**: @username (overall accountability)
- **Key Contributors**: @username, @username
- **Stakeholder Reviewers**: @username, @username
- **External Vendors**: Company name (if applicable)

## Communication Plan
- **Status Updates**: How often and to whom
- **Review Meetings**: Schedule and participants
- **Milestone Check-ins**: Timeline and format
- **Escalation Path**: Who to contact for issues
